red_expandrange.pro


Routines

top source red_expandrange

SST observations

result = red_expandrange(st_in)

Expand a comma separated list of subranges given as a string into an integer array.

Subranges can be of three kinds: 1. Single numbers, expands to the number.. 2. Dash separated numbers, '10-15' --> [10,11,12,13,14,15]. 3. Colon separated numbers with increments, '10:2:20' --> [10,12,14,16,18,20].

Return value

An integer array.

Parameters

st_in in type=str

This is the comma and dash separated list.
